failure_cause: Tier 1 pitch error along the note, worst frame = 3.3% misses <= 3.0% (judge floor on a perfect echo: 2.53%); Tier 1 spectrogram correlation, log-mel = 0.72 misses >= 0.8 (judge floor on a perfect echo: 0.976)

judge_floor.note: metrics of target * clap (band-limited): the floor set by the judge and the clap, not the design

caveats: 1 cm and 2 cm posts: forward/side scattering off the analytic cylinder at the 4 kHz grid (1 cm forward 1.04 dB, 90-degree 1.77 dB; 2 cm forward 1.47 dB, 90-degree 0.43 dB) (dipole part ~10 % strong for sub-cell posts; backscatter within 1 dB); effect on dense-field echoes is not bounded; shadowing and multiple scattering are checked by self-convergence only, not against an exact solution
1 cm posts fail backscatter at the 2 kHz grid: not validated there
the 1 cm backscatter match depends on an area factor fitted to backscatter (area factor 0.908; held-out offsets confirm backscatter only)
radii [0.01] used by this design are validated for backscatter but not at all angles at this grid (metrics.json:checks.cylinder.stage1_grid (f_max 4000.0 Hz, ppw 10.0))
verification.reason: validation passed and every radius used is validated at this grid

density_sweep.selection: lowest Tier 1 spectrogram loss (window_loss); judges not used

design_study_tier0.what: Tier 0 design study, stage 1 (2D mode for losses/judges, 3D for level)
design_study_tier0.selection: designs compared by Tier 0 spectrogram loss (window_loss) and its jitter robustness only; pitch error and log-mel correlation (judges) are recorded for information and never used to choose
design_study_tier0.jitter: radial (along the ray from the source), Gaussian sigma, seeds (11, 12, 13)

h2_tier1_vs_tier0.what: H2: Tier 1 vs Tier 0 on the same posts, and the Tier 0 radial jitter that reproduces the residue
h2_tier1_vs_tier0.selection: diagnostic only; nothing is chosen from this file
